nodes.label: YOUPI PG V2 Gateway
nodes.author: Gaurav / Zenuxs
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted zero-fee payment gateway using direct P2P UPI bank settlement and automated observers

nodes.label: QuickUPI Platform
nodes.rationale: Sovereign payment orchestration built on NPCI UPI avoiding aggregator licenses and escrow fees

nodes.label: Single-Slot FIFO UPI Queue Engine
nodes.rationale: Enforces 1-buyer-per-VPA invariant to prevent concurrent transaction attribution collisions without metadata

nodes.label: 64-Bit Integer Minor Units (Paise)
nodes.rationale: Amounts stored in integer paise strictly prevent floating point rounding inaccuracies in financial state

nodes.label: SaaS Subscription Pricing Model
nodes.rationale: SaaS subscription model aligns platform revenue with tooling value rather than taxing transaction volume

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Timers
nodes.rationale: Prevents client-side manipulation of payment expiry deadlines and quota locks

nodes.label: 0% Transaction Fee Model
nodes.rationale: Direct bank transfer without holding funds eliminates RBI aggregator license and 2-3% + GST charges

nodes.label: Research Scope & Regulatory Limits
nodes.rationale: Conservative testing limits of 20 txns/day and independent compliance verification safeguard experimental deployments
